candidate_grid_rule: Predeclare ascending pairs and repository allocations; reject any design whose exact 2^R repository sign-flip space cannot attain Holm-corrected alpha before evaluating power.

claims.broader_external_validity: requires prospectively justified repository/task sampling frame and interaction precision; cannot be inferred from nested executions
claims.primary_bounded_migration: requires the same exact repository sign-flip plus Holm production test, frozen effect thresholds, binding conjunction, and lower 95% power bound >=0.80
claims.repository_interactions: separately powered condition-by-repository contrasts with multiple independent repositories; primary N does not imply this claim
claims.task_class_interactions: separately powered condition-by-task-class contrasts with Holm correction

finite_cluster_eligibility.warning: Increasing pair count or randomization draws cannot improve the 2^R assignment resolution.

independence_guard: LOW/HIGH executions and templates inside a repository are never counted as independent repository observations.
reason: Only synthetic assumption regimes exist; legitimate outcome-blind nuisance bounds and frozen repositories/tasks do not.
selection_rule: After calibration only, among structurally eligible designs select the smallest design whose lower Wilson 95% bound is >=0.80 for the production-aligned primary conjunction in every defensible nuisance regime, with >=75% classifiable pairs; hash-bind inputs/engine/output. No cost- or outcome-based selection.
